signature.one_line: Credibility sandwich: raw selfie hook, then third-party receipts letterboxed on black with word-by-word white captions below, then selfie close.
unique_devices: Receipt inserts: news screenshots, quote cards and press graphics placed full-width on a black 9:16 canvas (image ~y 6-77 %), held ~90-120 frames each with native typography untouched; captions continue below on black
Three-block shape: selfie hook (~13 % of runtime) -> insert/b-roll block (~60 %) -> one long uninterrupted selfie close (~28 %)
Word-by-word reveal into a pre-laid centred block (partial lines look off-centre by design): fade + ~1 % H rise over 2 frames, lines at 79 / 82.4 % height, same position over selfie and inserts
signature.why_it_works: A personal contrarian line hooks instantly; third-party receipts turn a plain phone selfie into evidence, and the black letterbox keeps captions readable over any image.

hook.first_frame: raw handheld phone selfie close-up against a plain warm wall, first caption word appearing at ~79 % height

structure.what: short contrarian personal statement on the selfie
third-party receipts (article screenshot, quote card) backing the stance
introduce the person/company being backed with b-roll of them
what makes it different, cut between selfie, press graphic and product b-roll
zoom out to the bigger stakes with a headline image on black
long calm selfie close stating the decision and thanking

pacing.note: new insert every ~90-180 frames in the middle block; first and last blocks are long selfie holds

captions.what: word-by-word white captions in a pre-laid centred block, 1-6 words over max 2 lines, no box
captions.how: Poppins-like medium 57 px, line 1 centre y 79.0 %, line 2 82.4 % (pitch 3.4 % H); each word fades in + rises ~1 % H over 2 frames on its word (up to ~9 frames early); block hard-cuts out on the next clause

broll_inserts.what: receipt inserts: article screenshot, quote card, press graphic, headline image
broll_inserts.how: full-width on black, image band y ~6-77 %, static, ~90-120 frames each, hard cut in/out

broll_inserts.what: full-frame b-roll of the subject being discussed (person, place, product in use)
broll_inserts.how: full-bleed, static or handheld, 60-120 frames each; captions stay at 79 %

layout.how: image centred in the upper ~70 % of a black 9:16 frame so the caption band below stays on black
handheld phone, face centred, captions over the chest

case.caption: sentence case as spoken (capital 'I', capital at sentence start)

grouping.words_per_caption: 1-6 per block (≈3-4 visible), built word by word
grouping.sync: word-by-word: each word appears on (or up to ~9 frames before) its spoken word, in its final slot of a pre-laid-out centred block (partial lines look off-centre until complete)
grouping.break: new block per clause; the old block cuts out

layout.same_position_over_inserts: yes — inserts are letterboxed on black above (y ~6-77 %), captions stay at ~79 %

caption.font_class: geometric sans, medium (circular o and e, open wide spacing)
caption.calibration_note: calibration word 'school.' sits on line 2 (centre y 82.4 %)

animation.word_entry: each word fades in while rising ~1 % H into place over 2 frames (sits ~1 % low for one frame); no scale, no blur
animation.timing: on the word to ~9 frames early vs transcript word starts
animation.exit: hard cut of the whole block when the next clause starts

other_text_spec.text: news-article screenshot / quote card / press graphic / headline image placed full-width on a black 9:16 canvas (image roughly y 6-77 %), ~90-120 frames each, keeping their native typography; captions continue below at ~79 %
native logo in the footage only; no authored titles, lower thirds or end card

style.look_intent: warm, high-contrast, natural saturation; ungraded daylight phone look on the selfie, inserts keep their native colours

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic, speech-gap level -6 dB); calm, unobtrusive under a calm delivery
sfx: none; cuts are not hit (measured cut_hit_share 0.1)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: B-Roll Style
catalog_styles.role: receipt inserts and subject b-roll in the middle block

catalog_styles.name: Jump-Cut Editing
catalog_styles.role: hard cuts between selfie and inserts

use_when: a founder, investor or expert explains a decision or belief from a phone selfie
the user has receipts: article screenshots, press clippings, quote cards, headline images
delivery is calm and the credibility should come from evidence rather than effects
inserts come in mixed aspect ratios and need a uniform black letterbox
avoid_when: there are no third-party images or b-roll to insert
a high-energy, emphasis-heavy caption style or brand colour system is wanted
the speaker has no authority yet and the receipts would feel borrowed
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B06 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B06.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. All positions are % of frame; px are at 1080x1920.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} must stay >= 4.5:1 on {{SURFACE}} and >= 3:1 on the footage)
- {{TEXT}}      captions                          default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}    none (this blueprint has no emphasis colour; do not add one)  default none
- {{ACCENT_2}}  none                              default none
- {{SURFACE}}   letterbox canvas behind inserts   default #050405 (near-black)
- {{CARD_BG}}   none                              default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} captions                       default Poppins 500 (geometric sans medium)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    same as display                default Poppins 500
- {{HANDLE}}    not shown
- {{LOGO}}      not shown (only logos that are native to the b-roll)

CAPTIONS
1. English as spoken, sentence case (capital "I"); keep full stops, commas, apostrophes. No emoji, no highlight colour, no box.
2. Grouping: one clause per block, 1-6 words over at most 2 centred lines (~45 % of width max per line).
3. Type: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 57 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke, no shadow, no box.
4. Position: block centred horizontally; line 1 centre at 79.0 % of height, line 2 at 82.4 % (line pitch 3.4 % ~ 65 px). Same position over selfie footage and over inserts.
5. Animation (30 fps): lay out the full block centred first, then reveal each word in its final slot on its spoken word (up to ~9 frames early is fine): fade in while rising ~1 % of height over 2 frames. No scale, no blur. The whole block hard-cuts out when the next clause starts. Partial lines look off-centre until complete; that is correct.

OTHER TEXT
6. No authored titles, lower thirds or end card. For receipts, place each screenshot / quote / press image full-width on a {{SURFACE}} 9:16 canvas (image band roughly y 6-77 %) for ~90-120 frames, untouched, with captions continuing below at ~79 %.

EDIT DEVICES
7. Shape: selfie hook (~13 % of runtime) -> insert block (~60 %: receipts on {{SURFACE}} + full-frame b-roll of the subject, a new visual every ~90-180 frames) -> one long selfie close (~28 %). Hard cuts only, no punch-ins.

GRADE
8. Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: warm, high-contrast, natural saturation, daylight phone look; leave inserts in their native colours.

AUDIO
9. Calm unobtrusive music bed under the voice (optional); no SFX on cuts. Master to about -14.2 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test frame with the caption "KEY WORD" on line 1 over {{SURFACE}} and the word "school." on line 2, then measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.1,0.775,0.9,0.81 --ink "{{TEXT}}:50"
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.3,0.81,0.7,0.845 --ink "{{TEXT}}:50"
   Required: "school." ink 2.19 % ±0.5 of height and 18.3 % ±2 of width (at the default font); "KEY WORD" within ±0.5 % H of the value from video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py ({{FONT_DISPLAY}}, 57 px). Line centres within ±1 % of 79.0 / 82.4 %; colour equal to {{TEXT}}.
